verification_snapshots_text_bound.name: verification_snapshots_text_bound
verification_snapshots_text_bound.value: length("verification_snapshots"."id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(cast("verification_snapshots"."id" AS blob)) <= 512 AND length("verification_snapshots"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(cast("verification_snapshots"."name" AS blob)) <= 512 AND length(cast("verification_snapshots"."origin" AS blob)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND ("verification_snapshots"."session_id" IS NULL OR length(cast("verification_snapshots"."session_id" AS blob)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512)

verification_snapshots_time_bound.name: verification_snapshots_time_bound
verification_snapshots_time_bound.value: typeof("verification_snapshots"."captured_at") = 'integer' AND "verification_snapshots"."captured_at" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("verification_snapshots"."stored_at") = 'integer' AND "verification_snapshots"."stored_at" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991

verification_snapshots_source_bound.name: verification_snapshots_source_bound
verification_snapshots_source_bound.value: ("verification_snapshots"."source" = 'paired-sdk' AND "verification_snapshots"."session_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("verification_snapshots"."source" = 'imported-evidence' AND "verification_snapshots"."session_id" IS NULL)

verification_snapshots_digest_bound.name: verification_snapshots_digest_bound
verification_snapshots_digest_bound.value: length("verification_snapshots"."content_sha256") = 64 AND "verification_snapshots"."content_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length("verification_snapshots"."coverage_sha256") = 64 AND "verification_snapshots"."coverage_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

runs_with_hints.name: runs_with_hints
runs_with_hints.definition:
SELECT
    r.*,
    (SELECT s.model FROM spans s WHERE s.run_id = r.id AND s.model IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS model,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
                  AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('OK','ERROR') THEN 1 END)
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     FROM spans s WHERE s.run_id = r.id AND s.parent_span_id IS NULL) AS finished,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spans s WHERE s.run_id = r.id) AS span_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM live_events e WHERE e.trace_id = r.id) AS live_event_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(LENGTH(COALESCE(s.input_payload, '')) + LENGTH(COALESCE(s.output_payload, ''))), 0)
     FROM spans s WHERE s.run_id = r.id) AS payload_total_chars
  FROM runs r
